seoTitle: Avatar Generator: Initials and Identicons as SVG
metaDescription: Create default profile pictures as SVG from names: coloured initials or symmetric identicons. The same name always gives the same avatar.
intro: Generate placeholder avatars for users, teams or demos without uploading anything.
why:
Each name is hashed to a hue and a pattern. Initials mode draws the first and last initial on a coloured circle; identicon mode draws a symmetric 5 by 5 pixel pattern. Output is plain SVG with an accessible label, one image per name, and a preview sheet.

The hash is a simple non-cryptographic 64-bit mix, fine for decoration; do not use it to hide identities, since the same name always gives the same picture. Check colour contrast if you put text on the circles.

No data is sent anywhere: the work happens in your browser, so you can use it offline once the page has loaded.
howTo: Choose initials or identicon and a size.
Copy the SVG or save the preview.
Serve the SVG from your own origin.
